description: This file defines an interface `ServerRequestCreatorInterface` within the namespace `Nyholm\Psr7Server`. The interface specifies methods for creating server request objects from globals or arrays, and a static method for extracting headers from server variables. It is a part of a PSR-7 server request creation library.

methods.name: fromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a new server request object using current environment variables, defaulting to GET method and including current headers and body from php://input.

methods.name: fromArrays
methods.description: Creates a new server request object from provided arrays representing server, headers, cookies, GET, POST, files, and body.

methods.name: getHeadersFromServer
methods.description: Extracts and returns headers from the server variables array.
